body:
[closing keyword removed] #2891

## Problem

A host dockerd restart killed four `/codex` sessions for link-assistant/router #724, #725, #727 and #728. The bot then posted all their recovery-lifecycle comments, intermediate session logs and "restarted after a kill" notices on router [PR #721](https://github.com/link-assistant/router/pull/721). That is the plan PR of the parent issue #720, not one of the sessions' own PRs (#749, #750, #752 and #753). Two earlier completion kill-notices also landed there. In total, 14 comments went to the wrong PR.

## Root cause

`resolvePullRequestUrlForSession` (`src/session-monitor.lib.mjs`) returned `linkedPRs[0].url`. GitHub links every PR whose description closes the issue. #721 (branch `issue-720-…`, `[closing keyword removed] #720` … `[closing keyword removed] #741`) is linked to each sub-issue and comes first:

```
#724 → [#721 issue-720-99e7abc4e6c1, #749 issue-724-878028a21e67]
```

The session-log fallback took the first `…/pull/N` URL in the log, even one the log only mentioned. The answer was then cached in `sessionInfo.resolvedPullRequestUrl` and reused for every completion, kill notice and log upload of the session. `/merge` (`fetchReadyIssuesWithPRs`) had the same flaw: it took the oldest PR whose body closes the issue, which is the plan PR.

## Fix

- **The session's own PR comes first.** The resolver now scans the session log only for the lines solve prints for its own PR: `📍 PR URL:` (PR created), `PR URL:` (continue mode) and `📍 URL:` (final check by head branch). Other URLs in the log are ignored.
- **Linked PRs must belong to the issue.** `isIssueOwnPullRequest` and `getPullRequestPrimaryIssueUrl` (`src/github-linking.lib.mjs`) reuse `resolvePrimaryIssueNumber` (#2335 and #2563). A PR on `issue-<n>-` belongs to issue n. A PR on an ordinary branch belongs to its first closing reference. `selectIssueOwnPullRequest` skips every foreign PR. If no PR of its own exists yet, the resolver returns `null`: nothing is posted, and the lookup runs again at the next report.
- **The same selection applies everywhere.** Completion messages, the recovery lifecycle, kill notices and intermediate logs all go through the resolver. Batch linked-PR entries now carry `headRefName` and `primaryIssueUrl`. `/merge` sorts the issue's own PR first.
- **Verbose output.** `--verbose` logs each skipped linked PR with its branch and owning issue, the announced PR, and why no PR was chosen.

Solve itself already rejects PRs whose branch doesn't match `issue-<n>-` in auto-continue, so its own comments went to the right PRs.

## Reproduction and tests

- `node experiments/issue-2891-session-pr-selection.mjs --verbose` replays the captured linked-PR lists. The old rule gives #721 for all four issues; the new rule gives #749, #750, #752 and #753.
- `tests/session-pr-ownership-2891.test.mjs` (9 tests, captured router data) covers:
  - the ownership helpers;
  - the batch fields;
  - the selection;
  - the resolver with linked PRs only, `[#721]` → `null`, and with a log that mentions #721 but announces #749;
  - the announcement parser.
- The expectation in `tests/test-issue-1760-draft-linked-prs.mjs` now includes the two new fields.

## Case study

[`docs/case-studies/issue-2891`](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/tree/issue-2891-9cf3e081050b/docs/case-studies/issue-2891) contains:
- the timeline;
- all 17 comments on #721;
- the closing references and the sessions' own PRs;
- root causes, alternatives considered, online sources and a [requirements audit](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/blob/issue-2891-9cf3e081050b/docs/case-studies/issue-2891/requirements-audit.md).

No upstream issue was filed. GitHub's linking works as documented; the defect was in how hive-mind read the list.

**Known limitation:** a wrong `resolvedPullRequestUrl` already persisted by an older version, in a session that is still tracked, is still reused.

Release: patch changeset `.changeset/session-own-pull-request-2891.md`. Bun is also bumped from 1.4.2 to 1.4.3 in the three Dockerfiles, because the dependency-freshness gate failed [Checks and release 38029200793](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/actions/runs/38029200793) after Bun 1.4.3 was released while this PR was open. `tests/test-issue-2187-runtime-versions.mjs` now checks that the Bun pin is current, as it already does for Node.js, instead of requiring it to equal the Bun 1.4.2 that Box 2.10.3 ships; the layer installs the pinned Bun over Box's copy.
